most_similar_reason: Candidate 6 shares the target's core plot almost point for point: a supreme god angered by human wickedness sends a world-destroying flood, a single favored man is forewarned and builds a wooden vessel provisioned for survival, he and his family ride out the waters, give thanks/offer sacrifice on landing, and then repopulate the earth, with his offspring becoming the ancestors of named peoples.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 7 contains no narrative at all—only the bare identification of a spirit as a deity—so it shares no events, roles, or motifs with the target's flood-and-repopulation story.
